Title: IPluginServerService Contract
Summary: Contract for managing plugin distribution servers - add, remove, enable/disable servers.
Content:
# IPluginServerService Contract

## Namespace
`Cyrena.Extensa.Contracts`

## Purpose
Manages the registration and lifecycle of plugin distribution servers. End users can add their own custom servers.

## Methods

### GetAllServers()
```csharp
Task<IEnumerable<PluginServer>> GetAllServers();
```
Returns all registered servers (custom + default) ordered by priority and addition date.

### GetEnabledServers()
```csharp
Task<IEnumerable<PluginServer>> GetEnabledServers();
```
Returns only enabled servers ordered by priority. Used for package queries.

### GetServer(string serverId)
```csharp
Task<PluginServer?> GetServer(string serverId);
```
Gets a specific server by ID, or null if not found.

### AddServerAsync(PluginServer server, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
```csharp
Task<PluginServer> AddServerAsync(PluginServer server, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default);
```
Adds a new server. Auto-generates ID if not provided. Raises `ServersChanged` event on success.

### UpdateServerAsync(PluginServer server, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
```csharp
Task<PluginServer?> UpdateServerAsync(PluginServer server, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default);
```
Updates an existing server. Raises `ServersChanged` event on success. Returns null if server not found.

### RemoveServerAsync(string serverId, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
```csharp
Task<bool> RemoveServerAsync(string serverId, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default);
```
Removes a server. Raises `ServersChanged` event on success. Returns true if removed, false if not found.

### SetServerEnabledAsync(string serverId, bool enabled, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
```csharp
Task<bool> SetServerEnabledAsync(string serverId, bool enabled, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default);
```
Enables or disables a server. Disabled servers are excluded from package queries. Raises `ServersChanged` event on success.

## Events

### ServersChanged
```csharp
event EventHandler<IReadOnlyList<PluginServer>>? ServersChanged;
```
Raised when servers are added, updated, removed, or enabled/disabled. Notify consumers to refresh their cached server lists.
